error_reason: The Orchestrator declared a final answer ($1.08B for 1800 Owens Street) without any supporting evidence from the WebSurfer’s prior step. This premature and unsupported verification directly led to the incorrect final answer; requiring source-backed confirmation of the queried facts would have prevented the failure.

Had verification required source confirmation and relevance (apartment/condo unit in Mission Bay, year 2021), the error would have been avoided.
